full_name: Marvalee H. Wake | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Marvalee H. Wake, professor in the department of integrative biology at the University of California at Berkeley, is an evolutionary morphologist particularly interested in the evolution of live-bearing modes of reproduction.
